rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for someone who wants or eats unusually large amounts of food.

example.english: My younger brother is truly voracious; after finishing a bowl of rice, he wants another serving.
example.traditional: 我細佬真係大食，食完一碗飯仲要再添。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 lou2 zan1 hai6 daai6 sik6 sik6 jyun4 jat1 wun2 faan6 zung6 jiu3 zoi3 tim1

rows.note: Use this for someone avid or highly eager about reading, a hobby, or another interest rather than for literal hunger.

example.english: They have a voracious appetite for reading and often go to the library after work.
example.traditional: 佢熱衷閱讀，放工後成日去圖書館。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jit6 zung1 jyut6 duk6 fong3 gung1 hau6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 tou4 syu1 gun2
